start.text: You close your hand round the pin. It hums the way a Remnant hums, and what it hums is yours.
The east stair, turning always to the left. Wind coming down it off the lantern room, cold, smelling of oil and something hotter, pushing your hood back off your face.
A hand comes down from a turn above and pulls the hood forward, and pins it under your chin. "Keep it up. Nobody's to see your face on this stair tonight."
You're counting the landings out loud. The hand rests on your hood a moment. "Hush." You go on counting under your breath.
You hold on past where it let go of you. The stair goes on turning. Whoever the hand is, you never look up.
Then it's a bone pin in your palm again, worn smooth on one side.
